declared.title: Do people who highly value happiness tend to ruminate?

findings.text: In Japan too, students who valued happiness more ruminated more, at the same time and four weeks later

support.sentence: Consistent with our hypothesis, valuing happiness was concurrently and longitudinally associated with increased rumination after controlling for depressive symptoms.

findings.text: Once out of two studies, the link was stronger, not weaker, among the most interdependent students

support.sentence: Furthermore, Study 1, but not Study 2, indicated that the association between valuing happiness and rumination was stronger among students with highly interdependent self-construal than those with less interdependent self-construal.

limits: same Valuing Happiness Scale (worry items included)
